designSummary: Stepped design with four hospitals and six three-month periods; linear mixed model for time to first critical intervention.
sampleSize: About 2,860 calls a year give about 180 calls per hospital per three-month period. With a standard deviation of 6 minutes and an intracluster correlation of 0.04, the stepped design has about 85 percent power to detect a 2-minute reduction in time to first critical intervention.
primaryAnalysis: Linear mixed model with fixed effects for period and phase and a random effect for hospital.
secondaryAnalysis: Logistic mixed model for unplanned intensive care admission; descriptive counts of deaths.
missingData: Calls with missing intervention times are described and excluded from the primary model.
summary: About 180 calls per hospital per period give about 85 percent power for a 2-minute reduction.
